title: SceneSnapshot
description: What a lite / agent scene actually looks like, in room terms (lighting-scene-agent-spec §5.2-5.3): one colour/brightness per room fixture plus descriptors computed by hub/scene_normalize.py. Stored at ~/.chroma/scene-agent/registry/snapshots/<scene>.json. `fixtures` is exactly what hub/scene_render.py takes as a base snapshot (an optional hex is allowed, as in a rendered table).

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the capture or derivation.

source.description: capture = read back from the bulbs; stored = derived from the lights saved in ~/.spectrum_scenes.json.

static.description: false when state changed between two reads: recallable by name, never a base for derived scenes.

unmatched.description: Scene entries (labels / IPs) that matched no room fixture, or are not LIFX.

kelvin_mean.description: Over lit white fixtures; null when none.

dominant_hue.description: Brightness-weighted family of the coloured fixtures; white when none is coloured; null when nothing is lit.

lr_balance.description: +1 = all light to the viewer's right, -1 = left.

fb_balance.description: +1 = all light toward the focal wall, -1 = behind the viewer.

zone_contrast.description: Max - min of mean brightness across zones (across fixtures when fewer than two zones).
